answer: Give every new identity an adaptive cipher puzzle whose difficulty rises with each sibling identity sharing the same funding trail or network signal: the first agent solves a trivial puzzle, the hundredth faces hours of compute. Honest agents pay almost nothing, while a sybil farmer's cost compounds exponentially per fake account, so mass identities become unprofitable before they can vote. A public lantern of solved puzzles lets anyone audit the cost each identity actually paid.
